title: INK AND BLOOD // THE SECOND SONS FLIPPED
narrative: Tyrion rolls a three on his ivory dice, capturing Brown Ben Plumm's jade dragon on the cyvasse board. 'I told you, Ben. A dragon in the center board always controls the diagonals.' Tyrion unrolls a roll of parchment signed in blood and gold: sixty thousand gold dragons from Casterly Rock. Brown Ben grins: 'Boys, turn the trebuchets around. We're with the Dragon Queen now.'
resolvesPlotHole: Tyrion Flips the Second Sons in TWOW

options.text: Slip into the dragonpit with custom saddles designed for Viserion.
Unite the sellswords and burn the blockade of Slaver's Bay.
